book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: 2 KORIN Korin mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge arnu kuyarna

content: Kile ye ait keŋnu tane tugum prowamŋgit. Kuyar pasa ande teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Taŋgo armba ko keŋmba taŋgo ande nu mbar ande kina ŋguwaig le son ŋga te-tiwap ŋgate. Lo ... 17.6; ... 19.15

content: Ye buk ait arnu tane tugum prowen sulumba mbarmba minnaig mbal ta riroŋ pasa saniŋgen. Kile ye tane tugumŋge mine ndaka nane tane turmba maŋ riroŋ pasa ndui ta satiŋgamŋgit. Ye maŋ luka tane tugum prowi ta mbarde mbal ta siŋka mapeke nda.
Taŋawi le ye Kristus tuku pasa kukliwet taŋgo minet ta tane wamdus tero ndaka katesewamŋgaig. Kristus nu saŋgri suŋgo ŋak tane sinamŋge pirokate.

Nu saŋgri kugatok taŋaŋ minna le nane nu tumba ail kazrai mbolŋge balenaig ta Kuate tuku saŋgriŋge te-tina le kile abo ŋak minit. Sine mata taŋaŋ taŋgo ndo saŋgri kugatok mineg ta sine nu ndoŋ ulendika Kuate tuku saŋgri mbolŋge minmba saŋgri tambi tane kile-tidiŋgam tuku prowamŋgig.
Taŋgine ŋgamuŋgal son pileŋga kaŋgerap. Tane siŋka Kristus Yesus tuku ŋgamuŋgal son ŋgade e ko kuga. Nu tane sinamŋge minit le tane kamusde e ko kuga. Kuga ta tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal son ta mbarkamŋgat.
Wam ta mbolŋge sine tane pasa kuklimba tumtiŋgigeŋ mbal ŋgamuŋgal son tugusek ŋak ta katese mayewap.

Kuate nu tane turkuwa le mbar maŋau afu ke ndakap ŋga nu yabaŋmba mineg. Tane wam magenu kap le sine aposel tuku piro mayenu ŋguwaig ŋga idus ndaweg. Tane maŋau magenu ndo kam tuku iduseg. Afu sine piro maye ndaweg ŋgade ta sine piti ndasiŋgit.
Sine pasa tugusek te-ibeŋam tuku mine ndakeg. Pasa ta turam tuku ndo mineg.
Sine saŋgri kugatok mineg le tane saŋgri ŋak mayok kinig ta sine saŋgri kugatok minam tuku gare-garekeg. Tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal son lato lato saŋgri tiŋguwa ŋga Kuate yabaŋmba mineg.

Suŋgo nu tane kulatkam tuku piro sina. Ye tane tugum prowi sulumba pasa saŋgrinu satiŋgam kumuŋ ta ye taŋawam idus ndawet. Ta tuku tane kile-tidiŋgam tuku ye waŋe ndo kuyaret. Suŋgo nu ye tane saŋgri piletiŋgam tuku piro sina. Tane ŋaigo siglikam tuku piro se ndakina.
Kile ye pasa suluwamŋgit. Taŋgine mbar kile-tidiŋgap. Ye tuku pasa isap. Tane wamdus ulendika ŋgamuŋgal mukuk minap le Kuate nu tane ndoŋ minamŋgat. Kume pur maŋau ŋgamuŋgal mukuk maŋau nu tugu.
Tane taŋgine taŋgine tira kame ndoŋ muŋgu kume purkade maŋau ta alonu te-mayokap.
Kuate tuku mbal teŋge minig ta ŋakmba tane kaiye pasa tiŋgig.
Siŋgine Suŋgo Yesus Kristus nu tane ake sinaŋ make patikuwa. Kuate nu tane tuku kume purwa. Tukul Guwa nu tane ndoŋ muŋgu gare ŋak minwa. Son.
